messages:
Aisha (infra): Short postmortem follow-up: consolidating GPU autoscale remediation items into one thread. Please confirm owners and ACs; I'll nudge weekly.
Ben (sre): Got it. Please call out clear acceptance criteria so we can close cleanly.
Aisha (infra): Agreed. Items below with owners and ACs.

ITEMS: 
1) Reserve-guard policy (hard block + alerting) — owner=Ben; due=2026-04-07; AC=alloc attempts rejected at >=96% reserved_pool, PagerDuty fires on sustained rejections >2/min, excludes spot/backfill pools.
2) Scheduler bin-packing rollback + safer defaults — owner=Kai; due=2026-03-31; AC=staging shows <1.5% perf regression, no preempt storm in 24h stress test. Config diff posted.
3) Predictive headroom panel + runbook ramp command — owner=Ramon; due=2026-04-12; AC=dashboard with headroom_forecast panel, runbook step validated in staging drill.
4) Conservative surge detector + OpsBot gating — owner=Aisha+OpsBot; due=2026-04-18; AC=detector tags incidents with "surge-auto", only issues warm commands (no >15% auto spin), requires human confirm for large ramps.
5) Borrow/temporary-capacity drill — owner=Aisha; due=2026-04-09; AC=one simulated borrow approved via OpsBot with full audit entry.

Kai (scheduler): I'll take item 2. Plan: lower packing_factor to 0.7 in staging, add 60s eviction cooldown. Will run staged e2e 2026-03-27 and post perf samples.
Ben (sre): Taking 1 and supporting 5. Draft policy will reject new allocs when reserved usage >=96%; adding runbook with 2-person override token valid 10m. PR soon.
Ramon (capacity): Taking 3. Starting with EWMA+weekday features for forecast; will expose headroom_forecast for one region first. Dashboard link to follow by 2026-04-05.
Aisha (infra): OpsBot, add slash command /ops borrow-approve and require two approvers. Also tag detector-created incidents as "surge-auto".
OpsBot: automated-message: /ops borrow-approve created (2-approver flow). Incidents from detector tagged "surge-auto". Audit logging enabled.
Ben (sre): Quick Q: does the reserve-guard have an emergency override?
Aisha (infra): Yes — 2-person token (10m) recorded in audit log. Add to runbook.
Kai (scheduler): PR for scheduler prototype: https://git.redwood/example/pr/7110. Staging run scheduled 2026-03-27.
Ben (sre): PR for reserve-guard: https://git.redwood/example/pr/7111 (draft).
Ramon (capacity): Dashboard prototype: https://grafana.redwood/d/efgh/headroom-proto (will add forecast panels).
Aisha (infra): Weekly syncs: Wednesdays 11:00 PT. I'll mark items DONE in this thread with PR links + AC evidence. Keep canaries small and focused.
Ben (sre): Will post unit tests and canary gating once PR ready.
Kai (scheduler): If staging looks good, canary rollout 2026-03-30.
Ramon (capacity): Will run a forecast validation drill during the borrow drill and add MAPE metric to the dashboard.
OpsBot: automated-message: followup-tracker created; owners assigned: Ben, Kai, Ramon, Aisha. Next automated reminder in 7 days.
Aisha (infra): Thanks team. Paste PR links and short runbook snippets back into this thread as you create them. Closing note: isolate changes during canary windows.
